description:
Read the current purchase rules for a new offer: account requirement, guest booking and minimum pickup lead time. Use get_service_options for service scope and quote_ride for price. These rules do not authorize changes or cancellation of an existing booking.

Use the same offerKey and locale as the intended ride inquiry; comparing rules for a different service location can misclassify the pickup. Read again before prepare_offer because observedAt is an observation, not a validity deadline.

On unavailable, do not assume rules. The complete service and legal terms must still be reviewed on the resulting offer page before confirmation.

locale.description: Use the customer's requested language for text and booking links: en by default, de for German. Preserve it on retries; pickup times stay in the provider time zone.

offerKey.description: Optional existing published provider/supplier offer key. Selects its configured service location; it is not a customer bookingKey or bookingReference and grants no booking access.

name: get_customer_policy

status.description: The requested information could not be supplied safely; this is not vehicle-unavailability evidence.

bookingConfirmed.description: Reading policy does not create or confirm a booking.

bookingUrl.description: Published customer booking page for this provider and locale; the URL does not grant private booking access or confirm availability.

observedAt.description: Observation timestamp of the minimum-lead-time policy read; no validity window is promised.

revalidationRequired.description: Re-read and revalidate current policy before offer preparation/confirmation.

scope.description: These rules cover preparation of a customer offer/booking, not action authority.

status.description: Current booking-preparation policy was read; no booking is confirmed.

terms.description: Current published account, guest-booking, lead-time and confirmation rules.

accountRequired.description: Whether current purchase policy requires an account.

bookerForGuestAllowed.description: Whether current policy allows a booker to request service for another guest.

bookingConfirmation.description: Confirmation requires provider-confirmed full payment; an offer link alone is insufficient.

minimumLeadTimeMinutes.description: Current minimum time before pickup, expressed in minutes.

serviceSpecificTerms.description: Review the complete terms bound to the current offer before confirming.

timeZone.description: Configured local time zone for the selected provider/service location.
